ValidationRule.description: Performance may not exceed the manager's (VLOOKUP by name), scores move in half-point steps in 0-5, review timestamps are checked with DATETIMEVALUE/TIMEVALUE and the bio length is bounded by skills.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Employment_Type__c, 'Contractor')), OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Manager_Name_Ref__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Performance_Score__c)), Performance_Score__c > NULLVALUE(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Employee_Record__c.Fields.Performance_Score__c, $ObjectType.Employee_Record__c.Fields.Name, Manager_Name_Ref__c), Performance_Score__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Performance_Score__c)), OR( Performance_Score__c < 0, Performance_Score__c > 5, ROUND(Performance_Score__c * 2, 0) <> Performance_Score__c * 2 ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Last_Review_At__c)), OR( Last_Review_At__c > NOW(), DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(DATEVALUE(Last_Review_At__c)) & ' 23:59:59') < Last_Review_At__c, TIMEVALUE(Last_Review_At__c) < TIMEVALUE('06:00:00.000') ) ), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Bio__c)), LEN(Bio__c) > 2000, PICKLISTCOUNT(Skills__c) = 0) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Performance score, review timing or bio violates the manager/score rules.
